item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera notices that she looks like her parents, but her younger brother Aarav has a slightly different eye colour. Which statement correctly explains how reproduction produces both similarity and variation in a family?

options.A: Reproduction passes instructions from parents to children, and small changes in these instructions can cause variation.
options.B: Reproduction makes exact copies of the parents, so any variation must come from a completely separate process.
options.C: Reproduction only creates variation and plays no role in keeping children similar to their parents.
options.D: Variation appears only when the environment changes, and reproduction has nothing to do with it.
